queue.name: Zuluf Field-Ju'aymah Crude Oil Pipeline(s)
queue.note: New crude trunkline(s) (CRPO 79 / 'ZFJ-1', 2x 42-in onshore+offshore) from the Zuluf field/onshore CPF to Ju'aymah terminal, part of the Zuluf AH Crude Oil Increment (600 Mbcd); no existing row names Zuluf, Tanajib, or this route.

evidence.note: Zuluf expansion (600,000 b/d Arabian Heavy increment) includes new downstream pipelines carrying stabilized crude from the onshore CPF to the Ju'aymah crude oil terminal.
Confirms route Zuluf field -> Ju'aymah Terminal for stabilized crude via new downstream pipeline, operator Saudi Aramco.
McDermott in line for CRPO 79 package on Aramco's Zuluf offshore expansion.
Tender listing for CRPO 79: two 42-inch oil trunklines (east and west) plus a 42-inch water-injection line, onshore and offshore, tying Zuluf development into the export/processing chain.
Zuluf crude oil increment project still in active EPC as of Q2 2024, targeting completion around 2026.

queue.name: Safaniya Offshore-Onshore Crude Trunkline (CRPO 156)
queue.note: New 48-in, ~65km offshore + 12km onshore crude trunkline from Safaniya field, Saipem EPCI awarded Feb 2026; distinct route/length from existing P1958 (Safaniyah-Juaymah, 198km) and the Safiniyah-Khursaniyah family (P1964-1966/P5169, 106km).

evidence.note: Saipem awarded ~$500m EPCI contract (CRPO 156) for a 48-inch crude trunkline, ~65km offshore + 12km onshore, from Safaniya oil field to an onshore processing facility.
Confirms same contract scope and dimensions for Safaniya field trunkline.
Independent trade-press confirmation of the Safaniya trunkline EPCI order under Aramco's long-term offshore framework.

queue.name: Abu Safa Field Crude Trunkline (CRPO 138)
queue.note: New 42-in, ~50km crude trunkline for the Abu Safa (Abu Saafa) offshore field, shared 50/50 with Bahrain; Saipem EPCI awarded July 2024. No existing row names Abu Safa as an endpoint (nearest is unrelated P0637 Bahrain Saudi Arabia Oil Pipeline, Abqaiq->Bapco Refinery).

evidence.note: Saipem awarded EPCI for a ~50km, 42-inch crude trunkline for the Abu Safa Field, part of a combined ~$500m award under its Aramco long-term agreement.
Trade-press confirmation of the same Abu Safa 42-inch, ~50km crude trunkline EPCI scope.

queue.name: Berri Downstream Pipeline (Abu Ali Island-Khursaniyah-Ju'aymah)
queue.note: New 30-in crude + 10-in sour condensate lines from Aramco's Abu Ali Island processing plant to Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Ju'aymah tank farm, part of the Berri Increment Program; endpoints don't match existing P1970 (Abu Ali-Berri junction) or P1978 (Berri junction-Ras Tanura), or the Saudi Aramco Concession->Ras Tanura KRT family.

evidence.note: Saipem project page: EPCI of two new downstream pipelines (30-in stabilized Arabian light crude + 10-in sour condensate) connecting Abu Ali Island processing plant to Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Juaymah tank farm 'via expanding the existing KRT pipeline corridor', part of the Berri Increment Program (+250 Mbcd crude).

dropped.name: East-West Pipeline / Petroline Capacity Expansion (proposed 2026) [leads2026 + news, merged]
dropped.reason: Preliminary/unconfirmed press reporting only (Aramco 'declined to comment'; no FID, contractor, route, or diameter). Explicitly framed by both strategies as additive capacity on the existing East-West/Petroline corridor already on the roster (P0551 mainline, P2017 expansion, P5195 Shaybah-Abqaiq capacity-expansion segment) rather than a confirmed distinct pipeline -- one source floats a possible separate smaller products line, but nothing concrete enough to add-threshold. Track as a monitor item for a future pass rather than a discovery row.
